description: This file defines a custom report class for generating an XML report of stock quantities by location in OpenERP/Odoo, including methods for processing location data and generating XML output.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: A custom report class inheriting from report_rml, responsible for creating XML stock location reports.

methods.name: create_xml
methods.description: Generates an XML report of stock quantities by location, including nested child locations.
